about: Text-to-video lineup exported from videobench for RigMatch's Video Lab. Workflows are ComfyUI API format using core nodes only; replace the string __PROMPT__ with the user's prompt and the seed/noise_seed values (24) with the run's seed. File bytes and sha256 come from each repo's Hugging Face tree at export time.

dropped.wan-2.2-5b: the community turbo exists only as GGUF; wan-2.2-5b-official covers the model
